hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if git diff --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then echo "[aida] clean tree - pulling + building..."; git pull --ff-only && make build; else echo "[aida] dirty working tree - skipping git pull and make build"; fi; git -C "$HOME/.aida/brain" pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || echo "[aida] brain pull skipped"
